evidence_kind: real provider extraction; automated original-source review, not human or independent legal review

issues: Administrative registration, reporting, and tenant-rights notice obligations are included as ancillary Rent Ordinance obligations under rent_increase_limits. They do not establish that partially covered units have rent ceilings.

All six categories were reviewed. The source supplies no supported provisions or express jurisdiction-wide negative findings for security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. Silence does not establish the absence of rules.
Coverage classifications and exemptions are incomplete. The rent_ordinance_coverage fact must be independently supported, not inferred solely from construction year, ownership, or subsidy status.
Fine authorization is distinguished from an adopted fine system. The source establishes no adopted fine schedule, penalty amount, or later dated status for that authorization.

No overall effective date, exclusive end date, or dated lifecycle snapshot is supplied. Retrieval time is not status_as_of. Tenancy-start and utility-charge triggers are not converted into general effective dates or enactment events.

The overview and detailed sections differ in their description of shared-facilities residence timing, lease-renewal refusal, utility charging, and lease-breach notices. Rule-level review issues preserve these interpretation questions.

The source also describes tenant association creation, organizing activities, and a duty for landlords and tenant associations to confer in good faith about landlord-tenant relations, rent increases, habitability, and common interests. Those standalone organizing obligations are outside the six-category taxonomy; the rent-decrease remedy is extracted.

The source identifies federal, state, or administrative prohibitions on rent control without exact legal citations. It therefore cannot support schema-compliant directional supersedes or conflicts_with interactions.

This is official Rent Board guidance, not ordinance legal text. It reports voter passage and operative changes but supplies no ordinance section numbers; citations identify the ordinance and Measure BB without invented sections.

review_findings: 25 final rules; all 90 embedded evidence/event spans exact.
5% limits the annual General Adjustment and preserves banked increases over 5%, original [11884,12265).
Nonpayment trigger is at least one month regional HUD Fair Market Rent, not contract rent, [6660,7033).
Tenancy-notice threshold 2024-12-20 [8886,9296) remains separate from utilities-tenancy threshold 2024-02-06 and utility charge date [9758,10071).
Shared-facility exemption requires landlord residence at tenancy start [3350,3556).
Subsidy full/partial coverage and flattened-table qualifiers remain unresolved [4029,4234).
No invented effective/end/status snapshot/events; all 25 need review.
Many predicates use facts absent from the shared registry. rent_ordinance_coverage is a legal classification dependency, not a renter factual question.
No demonstrated source contradiction in the selected checks; no complete legal accuracy claim.
